split_strategy: Approximate 90/10 validation split, stratified by mother_tongue, type, level, and turn count within each source.

suggested_sampling.for_single_merged_train_file: If you train from the merged train file only, consider duplicating the gold set 2x to 3x in the training input if validation quality on tutor behavior is weak.
suggested_sampling.reason: Gold examples provide a cleaner signal for clarification-first tutoring behavior, while v3 provides breadth and coverage.

recommended_training_notes: Keep validation unweighted so behavior regressions are easier to see.
Monitor JSON validity, question-asking behavior, and non-repetition of learner text during eval.
If the model becomes too corrective, increase the effective gold ratio before increasing total steps.
